text: In this last unit Alex says goodbye to Berlin at a graduation celebration (Abschlussfeier) in a courtyard and Marco gives a short presentation. In this last unit you will talk about the German-speaking countries today: cities and regions, culture and everyday life, festivals and celebrations. You will say what you like (Das gefällt mir), give your opinion, congratulate someone and prepare a short presentation. There is almost no new grammar: the grammar section brings together the main patterns of units 1 to 11, and the last exercise checks the whole course. The scenes are set in places you may know: a seminar room, a pub, a museum, a flat share, a travel agency and an office.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
